capabilities: Notify at startup when the inbox note or folder has unprocessed content
Track a single note or a folder of files as the inbox
Compare inbox contents against a last-tracked snapshot or a user-defined base content
Set the notice duration, including an infinite notice
disambiguation: Not a task manager or capture tool; it only notifies about new content in an existing inbox note or folder.
extras: Can also be installed via the BRAT plugin, though the community store is recommended; documentation covers settings with an example of base contents.
motivation: The author processes content written to the vault by third-party tools into an inbox note and wanted a reminder at startup when new content has arrived.
problem: Quick-capture tools written from outside Obsidian leave content in an inbox note or folder, but Obsidian gives no signal at launch that new content is waiting to be processed.

relations.evidence: Thank you to marcusolsson for obsidian-svelte that I used for creating many of the UI elements.

summary: Startup notifier that shows an in-app notification when an inbox note or folder contains content waiting to be processed.
